generation.scope: Every connected reduced pure open-and-closed curve in a point-fiber graph has positive arithmetic genus. In genus one it is smooth elliptic or a rational nodal polygon. Five-line polygons are impossible: two opposite contractions of the Frobenius tensor would fix every vertex, whereas the canonical shift is a fixed-point-free rotation. This closes every reduced genus-one quintic hull, leaving only the two smooth elliptic classes.

open_mathematics: Analyze reduced genus-two quintic hulls with length-two discrepancy via their quadric and dualizing pencils, and nonreduced curves, reducible sextics and general AS tests.
